dedupe_keys.name: finnish prtr data web service code

description: PRTR is a Finnish web service for preparing and publishing pollutant release and transfer register data. Its repository says the Ministry of the Environment funded the project and the Finnish Environment Institute implemented it. The code includes a user interface and API; a development API is described as serving Finnish PRTR records. Users query facility, pollutant and release information through the deployed service or run the code with its own data load. Geographic coverage of that API is Finland, within the broader European PRTR reporting system. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the code. A limitation is that the development endpoints and current reporting years may change; public data terms and completeness must be checked at the source independently of the software licence. The service can prepare industrial emissions context for air, water or emergency scenarios. The related QGIS catalogue platform provides GIS processing, not this register API. No PRTR records or application code were downloaded.
